source_snapshot.test_name_items: Check switch function about ME recover
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check switch function about ME recover
1.Make Switch to another side.
2. Power on system , negative to jumper function page check.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Switch to another side , systerm still can power onsuccessfully.
2. Switch need functionaly.
3. Switch to orginal side , system should not hang or create error log.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: this switch-function check for ME recovery (via the ME-recovery path) requires physically moving the ME-recovery jumper to the other side, powering on to the jumper-function page in BIOS to confirm the feature engages, then returning the switch and confirming the system powers on with no hang/error. Toggling the onboard jumper and reading the BIOS ME-recovery path page is physical/Pre-OS work only a person at the machine can do.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator toggles the ME-recovery jumper (ME-recovery path), powers on, reads the BIOS jumper page, restores the switch, and confirms a clean power-on with no error log; agent cannot operate the motherboard jumper.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: physical/hardware operation at the machine - human only; agent must not attempt.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO. Correctly identifies the ME-recovery switch, physical Pre-OS boundary and restore path.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED. V2 adds ME/BIOS identity, recovery image/rollback safeguards and proof of no unauthorized firmware change.
historical_reviews.v3: No V3 Pilot record exists for this source key.
historical_reviews.v3_1: No V3.1 200-case record exists for this source key.

original_test_intent: Verify the physical ME-recovery switch path enters the expected recovery-mode firmware page/behavior, then returns to normal management and boot operation after the switch is restored.
original_method: A qualified operator captures ME/BIOS state, de-energizes the board, records and moves the identified recovery switch, powers on and observes the approved Pre-OS response without initiating an unapproved update, powers down, restores original position and verifies clean boot/ME health.
manual_activity: The core action is physical ME-recovery switch manipulation and direct Pre-OS observation. An agent cannot move the switch or prove the displayed recovery mode remotely.
required_inputs: Exact board and ME-recovery switch reference/map
Original/alternate orientation and expected BIOS/ME page behavior
ME/BIOS firmware identities, approved recovery image/path and rollback if applicable
Power discharge/ESD, boot timeout and console/OOB recovery
Final state, operator and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Never move the switch while powered and do not act on uncertain board identity.
Do not start firmware recovery or use an image unless separately approved and matched to the platform.
Stop on boot failure, unexpected firmware write/state, OOB loss or inability to restore original position.
Preserve first evidence and do not automatically reboot, retry or flash.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only board/ME/BIOS firmware, console, BMC/SEL and host-health baselines/results.
Correlate operator position evidence with the approved recovery-page response and restored firmware identity.
Do not manipulate hardware, initiate recovery or issue the verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve switch/recovery semantics and any image/rollback plan.
Perform all physical moves and screen observations.
Verify original position, ME/boot recovery and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its no-command/manual conclusion and restore sequence are appropriate; no remote substitute is valid.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the physical/Pre-OS method and use read-only firmware/health queries only as corroboration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Alternate side, ME recovery page, original-side restoration, no-hang/no-error and 10/20-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN PHYSICAL ME-RECOVERY SWITCH TEST WITH FIRMWARE INTEGRITY CONTROL
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use board-specific position photos, console capture, before/after ME/BIOS identity and management-health checks; prevent any firmware write unless covered by a separate approved plan.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact motherboard, ME firmware and recovery switch design.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, BIOS, ME and BMC firmware revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner ME recovery-switch, image compatibility and rollback specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds firmware-integrity and rollback boundaries without replacing the physical switch.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; alternate recovery behavior and restored normal operation remain required.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Switch map, recovery semantics, firmware identities and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Recovery-mode visibility does not authorize or prove a safe firmware update.

project_override_considerations: A project may limit this case to entering and exiting recovery mode. Any actual ME image operation is separate approved coverage and must name the image, target and rollback.
expected_evidence: Board/ME/BIOS/switch map, recovery expectations, image/rollback policy and authorization
Original/alternate switch photos and power/console timestamps
Expected ME recovery page/behavior with firmware/BMC/SEL evidence
Original-side restoration, unchanged or approved ME identity, normal boot/management health and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Despite awkward function-page wording, title, criteria and historical context consistently indicate ME recovery-mode verification followed by restoration.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Switch mapping and ME recovery semantics can be supplied; the operator can execute the physical mode-entry/exit without an actual firmware write.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree with NO and preserve its ME-specific restore path.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and firmware-integrity safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps optional recovery-image work outside this physical switch acceptance unless separately approved.

review_improvement: Distinguishes proving recovery-mode entry from performing a risky ME update and requires evidence that normal firmware/management state returns.
independent_technical_reasoning: ME recovery mode is selected by a physical board switch and observed before the OS. Supporting firmware identity can be read remotely, but it cannot execute or prove the physical path, so the case is MANUAL ONLY.
